name: Mirum Orbis
storyline:
The Divinities of Dawn regularly create new divine souls to strengthen their ranks and continue their eternal war against the Divinities of the Void. These two opposing yet inseparable forces maintain the fragile balance of the world of Ereda.

You are one of these primary souls, forged by the light of Dawn.
However, fate leads you far from the celestial conflict. Through mysterious circumstances, you are transported to one of Ereda’s continents: Otium.

There, the war of the gods will soon feel distant, for another threat looms in the shadows. A criminal organization spreads its influence, led by Loukyo, known as the Crimson Tear, whose reach extends deep into the highest spheres of society.
summary: Mirum Orbis is a 2D MMORPG developed by the French studio Askilian. The game features a variety of classes, an immersive storyline, and challenges to tackle both solo and in groups. It revisits the legacy of classic MMOs through a modern, dynamic, and visually fluid approach.
